thread:
Mia Chen: Quick async standup — BluRiver renewal this week. What I did: confirmed they saw intermittent 503s on embeddings (us-west-2). Blockers: can't reproduce locally and the error window overlaps their renewal prep. Today: need eng help to triage and a short canary if possible.

Ram Singh: Can you paste a couple of sample request IDs and the approximate times?

Mia Chen: Sure — IDs: `req_8f3a2`, `req_a77b9`, `req_1c2d3`. Spike ~14:03–14:09 PT. Customer on a renewal call 11am PT tomorrow, they're nervous about SLA.

Josh Patel: Quick dashboard check — I see a burst of 5xx coming from embedding worker pool (node group g4-3d-11). Error rate + latency spike align with big batches. Suspect batching overload. Suggest temp lowering `max_batch_size` for BluRiver route to 8. :thinking_face:

Sophie Alvarez: If we change only their route, what's the risk to other tenants? We need a safe canary and comms for the renewal call.

Ram Singh: We can do a route-level canary (override config just for blu-river-embeds). I can push the canary at ~14:30 PT. Blocker: need a short deployment window and a watch party. @Josh can you monitor? @deploy-bot please schedule.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary rollout for route `blu-river-embeds` at 2965432190; override `max_batch_size=8` for 10 minutes. Logs will post to #eng-releases and metrics to perf-dashboard.

Josh Patel: I'll watch error rate and 95/99latency. If 5xxs drop we'll keep the override and open a config PR to make it permanent for their plan. If not, rollback and escalate to runtime team.

Mia Chen: Thanks — I'll prep a 1-slide summary for the renewal meeting and be ready to tell the customer we ran a targeted canary. Please ping here with pass/fail.
